audit.method: Read-only SHA-256/SRI comparisons. Remote bytes were fetched into memory and inspected as bytes/archives; no fetched script or JAR was executed.
scope: Bundled Leaflet 1.9.4 JS, CSS and LICENSE
Gradle 8.13 wrapper JAR, gradlew and gradlew.bat
Google Play services release notes and Maven metadata for play-services-location 21.3.0

official_download_page.result: Both local JS and CSS SRI values match the official download page.

source_archive_observations: LICENSE is an exact byte match to the bundled LICENSE
The source archive does not contain dist/leaflet.js; the upstream FAQ says built files are supplied through the download/package distribution.

security_sources.observed_text: There aren't any published security advisories.
security_sources.applicability: No maintainer-published GitHub repository advisory was listed at retrieval time; this is not proof of no vulnerabilities.

security_sources.source_type: GitHub Advisory Database entry, sourced from NVD
security_sources.version_claim: Leaflet versions up to and including 1.9.4
security_sources.claim: XSS via bindPopup() when attacker-controlled input is rendered as raw HTML.
security_sources.applicability: Version-applicable alert recorded by the database; whether it applies depends on whether the application passes attacker-controlled content to the documented HTML sink.

security_sources.claim: Maintainers state that CVE-2025-69993 describes documented, intentional HTML rendering behavior, place sanitization responsibility on the calling application, and say they formally disputed the CVE with MITRE.
security_sources.applicability: This is the maintainer position and does not remove the need to inspect this app's actual popup/tooltip inputs.

gradlew.comparison: raw bytes differ; LF-normalized semantic diff is one line

gradlew.bat.comparison: raw bytes differ; CRLF/LF plus one line after LF normalization

script_diff.gradlew.bat: Upstream set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS=-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 "-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"; local set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m". Local file uses CRLF; upstream raw file uses LF.
script_diff.interpretation: The JAR matches exactly. Script mismatches are recorded for primary review; this evidence does not classify them as malicious or benign.

official_distribution_checksums.note: The 130.64 MB binary distribution itself was not downloaded; only the official checksum text was fetched and compared with gradle-wrapper.properties.

release_notes_observation.observed_text: The latest updates to several libraries changed minSdkVersion to 21 and updated play-services-base, play-services-basement and play-services-tasks dependencies; the artifacts list includes play-services-location:21.3.0.
release_notes_observation.security_observation: The read 21.3.0 release-note entry contains no explicit security advisory or security fix for play-services-location.
release_notes_observation.latest_setup_observation: The current setup page lists play-services-location:21.4.0, so 21.3.0 is no longer the current example version as of this audit.

google_play_services_location.bounded_result: No version-specific Google security alert was found in the official release-note entry read for 21.3.0; this is a release-note observation, not a claim that the SDK or all transitive dependencies have no vulnerabilities.

limitations: This is provenance and bounded advisory evidence, not a complete vulnerability assessment or a final security verdict.
The GitHub Advisory Database record and official Leaflet maintainer statement conflict on whether CVE-2025-69993 is a Leaflet vulnerability; application input flow determines practical exposure.

The official Leaflet source tag omits the built JavaScript file; the exact built-file comparison therefore uses the official Leaflet npm 1.9.4 package and unpkg distribution, while source-tag LICENSE/package metadata were checked separately.
Wrapper scripts do not hash-match the Gradle v8.13.0 tag and require primary review; only the wrapper JAR and official distribution checksum matched exactly.
